item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 23 #VISPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 23 #VISPRSD
Issued at 10:58 PM 24 October 2026

Moderate to Heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Iloilo(Badiangan, Janiuay, Lambunao), #Capiz(Tapaz, SapiAn, Ivisan, Sigma, Dao, Panitan, MaAyon, Pontevedra), #Aklan(Altavas, Batan), #NegrosOccidental(Pulupandan, Valladolid and BagoCity) within the next 30 minutes to an hour.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Capiz(Jamindan and Mambusao) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides. Keep monitoring for updates.
